snippet.title: Rusty Hearts OST - My heart is crying (by Sascha Greuel)
snippet.description:
We would like to thank all the fans who helped bring life to all the characters in Rusty Hearts. Your loyalty, dedication, and countless hours crawling through dungeons is what made it all possible. Rusty Hearts was a unique experience and will be cherished forever.
